# Draft:Hòa Hưng ward

Hòa Hưng is one of the 168 new neighboorhoods of Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam. It is home to the infamous Chí Hòa Prison during the Indochina wars. Hòa Hưng was established in 2025 by merging the entirety of ward 12,13,15 with parts of ward 14 of the former District 10, which was dissolved following Vietnam's 2025 administrative reforms.
